g.text: BA-B roof (NAIP 2024, by eye +-3 m [obs]; moved back by the 13.1 m outer-roof
relief, 5.1 m W [inf]): three planted sunken roof wells on the WNW side
(green; "roof wells" [pub CDR 2016]) crossed by two bridges (white; they continue W
off the roof - walkway links?) [obs]; two skylight grids (blue,
cross-hatched); PV row fields (hatched; 1.0-1.2 MW, ~3,000 panels [pub];
rows ~5.5 m at ~9 m pitch [obs]); all clipped to the roof (outline
+2.5 m) [inf]; heights of the wells, bridges and skylights

path.style: fill: #ffffff; opacity: 0.85

g.text: BA-D head: two round drums D ~19 m [obs, NAIP roof circles,
dotted = as imaged]; drawn moved back by the relief of a ~13 m top
(lean 0.58 m/m) [inf]; ~4-5 m above the adjacent roof [obs, low];
linear skylights / angular roof-plane edges (dashed, as imaged
less the 8.5 m roof relief) [obs / inf]

path.style: fill: #ffffff; opacity: 0.85

g.text: BA-F hub: octagonal rotunda [pub CDR massing], 74.2 m across
(regular octagon fitted to the SFO Museum outline, residual 0.01 m) [obs];
NAIP 2024: the 4 free faces put the roof edge on it (-0.3 / +0.2 m) at
octagonal lantern / skylight rings 19.4 / 13.4 m [obs, NAIP]: its 2020
shadow bounds the rise to <= 4.6 m, so it is drawn ECCENTRIC,
3.3 m E of the hub centre [inf]; heights unknown [unk]

path.style: fill: #ffffff; opacity: 0.85

g.text: BA-F NW arm: central roof monitor / light strip ~8 m wide
[obs, NAIP, low contrast]; drawn less the ~11 m roof relief [inf];

path.style: fill: #ffffff; opacity: 0.85

g.text: lean-free edges (thick blue): ESE 2.3 m outside, WNW 1.7 m
inside the level-2 outline; width 54.3 m [obs]

path.style: fill: #ffffff; opacity: 0.85

g.text: BA-B north half: outer roof edges not measured [unk];
roof features drawn from NAIP (wells, bridges, skylights, PV)

path.style: fill: #ffffff; opacity: 0.85

g.text: BA-B raised central roof (hatched) along the WHOLE pier, t -1236..-946
(290 m: the straight pier, from its bend towards T1 Center to ~20 m short of the
tip; the oblique north wing beyond the bend not tested [unk]) [obs: its 2020 shadow on the lower
ESE band, 4.87 m long at 144 stations, = a 5.9 m step everywhere;
2020-24 parallax 3.40 / 3.65 m (S / N) vs 2.30 / 2.60 m at the outer lip];
top ~19.1 m (N half 18.9-21.0) if the outer roof is 13.1 m throughout [inf];
ESE edge s -391.0 (thick, obs); WNW edge s -423.4: 2024 wall band over the wells

path.style: fill: #ffffff; opacity: 0.85

g.text: SFO Museum boarding-area polygons are departure-level (sfo:level 2) floor
outlines, verified on record 1947304261 (BA-B): they are not roof outlines.
The measured lean-free roof edges lie, from the outline (shapely, + =
outside): BA-B ESE +2.3 / WNW -1.7 m; BA-D +2.4 / -1.4 m; BA-F ESE 0.0 (on the
outline) / WNW -1.0 to -1.3 m. Spec frame range: 0-5 m outside (ESE), 0-2 m
Heights scale with the 2020 sun (|s20| 1.25, range 1.19-1.31): x0.95-1.05.
Measured stretches only (labels name them); other parts of the piers are
The T1 "70 ft skylight trusses / four 180 x 30 ft reflectors" belong to the
ITB main hall (refuted for T1 in the verification).
BA-D DOF points 06-035320/21/30 lie 24-37 m outside the pier (DOF 1A = +-6 m):
they are not BA-D; 06-035332 is an apron object.
